scope: The PDF Tools bundle in App Hub's card-host with hidden windows on macOS (Apple silicon), on its developer fixture: the sample PDFs plus the answers octosense-pdf-service gave for them, recorded by its pdftools_fixture example. card-host serves no host services, so no call reached a live engine.

card_host.runtime: the root's .sources: makepad 32d6415f with runtime-patches tree 7c859055, Octoscript-Makepad 33dea2f1, Octoscript 2e37d9e6
card_host.admitted: card-host: os.pdftools 0.1.0 admitted — capabilities {"storage"}, hosts {}, storage 67108864 bytes, agent none

runs.light: MAKEPAD_WIDGET_STYLE=macos, fixture; then a restart on the same storage
runs.missing: MAKEPAD_WIDGET_STYLE=macos, the sample PDFs without the fixture: the host refuses pdf.*

checks: Library lists the samples with first pages and '4 pages  ·  9 KB'; Open from this device says it is coming
Field guide opens on its page grid; a page opens large; Next goes to page 3
Text shows 'PAGE 1'; finding 'wren' reports '2 pages contain “wren”.'
Info shows 'A4, 210 × 297 mm', 'Not protected' and the four fonts
Split every 2 pages previews 'Makes 4 files'; Where I choose marks 'File 2 starts here' and offers 'Split into 2 files'
Light splits at page 2 (2 files, Pages 2–7); dark splits every 2 pages (4 files, Page 7)
Merge: choose Quarterly report and Board minutes, move Board minutes up, merge into 'Merged': '6 pages  ·  13 KB', opens
Damaged scan reads 'Couldn't open this PDF' with the engine's message
After a restart the library still lists Merged with '6 pages  ·  13 KB' and it opens
Without the fixture the host's refusal is shown and Merge PDFs explains itself
An empty library says no PDFs are there and that opening from the device is coming
No [E], on_render or callback error lines in any card-host log
visual_review: every frame inspected; original /g?raw=1 PNGs, not cropped or repainted
not_verified: the live pdf engine through this app in a shell (needs the pdf capability in App Hub and the per-caller engine areas)
the desktop shell's window sizes and on_app_resize column changes
Linux, Windows and phones (PDF Tools ships in the desktop shell only)
